manual.title: Deliver the prepared pelvis and waist
manual.body: The bulky fixture supplies the bridge, both socket housings and the waist. Insert both waist neutral pins on the pelvis before the crane will lift it. The yaw pin is on the front of the waist and the lean pin is on the right side; both start pulled out. Aim at each pin and press E. At the crane console, choose Move to pickup. Lower the crane, attach all four lifting adapters, then Raise crane. Choose Move to delivery and Lower crane to seat the bridge on the gantry bearings. Close all four gantry jaws with their handles, check that both pins are still in, then detach and stow the crane ends. The legs can dock only after this support is secure.

manual.title: Travel and seat the supported leg
manual.body: The pelvis bridge, both sockets and their bridge bolts are supplied context. Keep the rail engaged throughout travel, tilt and upward docking. Use local rail Advance controls through each supported stage; Stop holds the current stage. Retention is performed from the personnel lift. Retention blocks loaded Return.

manual.title: Seat the leg in the pelvis
manual.body: With the completed leg, neutral source roll and parked empty crane, select the left hip lane. Advance first stows the foot bolster, then indexes and pins the transverse table. Further Advance commands travel, turn upright and dock upward. The shared hip platforms open before loaded movement and restore after seating. The holder stays engaged: ball seating alone does not secure the leg.

diagram_views.title: Seat the leg in the pelvis

manual.title: Carry retaining half 1
manual.body: E picks up either PV-120 half with both hands. Carry it onto the personnel lift and click the shelf to store it. The shelf holds one two-hand component or two one-hand components; take one half per trip. Ride Up, E-pick it from the shelf, then aim and click its underside connection around the already seated hip neck. Either physical half fits either destination.

manual.title: Fasten retaining half 1
manual.body: Pocket two LG-W24 washers and two PV-H24140 M24 x 140 bolts at ground level. Fit each washer then its bolt upward from the seated half's underside into the existing socket flange. The shared LG-W24 stock also supplies the fork flange. Keep rail assistance engaged; a single fastened half cannot retain the complete hip.

manual.title: Carry retaining half 2
manual.body: E picks up either PV-120 half with both hands. Carry it onto the personnel lift and click the shelf to store it. The shelf holds one two-hand component or two one-hand components; take one half per trip. Ride Up, E-pick it from the shelf, then aim and click its underside connection around the already seated hip neck. Either physical half fits either destination.

manual.title: Fasten retaining half 2
manual.body: Pocket two LG-W24 washers and two PV-H24140 M24 x 140 bolts at ground level. Move toward the hip-facing end of the lift's working corner to see the far underside washer seats past the beam. Fit each washer then its bolt upward from the seated half's underside into the existing socket flange. The shared LG-W24 stock also supplies the fork flange. Keep rail assistance engaged; a single fastened half cannot retain the complete hip.

manual.title: Fit the hip stop cage
manual.body: With both ring halves and all four ring bolt pairs fitted, carry the two identical PV-130 stop-cage halves around the already retained neck. Their lower lip surrounds the prepared stop tongues; the cage limits motion and does not replace the ring or the engaged holder.

manual.title: Secure the cage seams
manual.body: Fit four LG-W12 washers and four PV-H12060 M12 × 60 screws through the four front-facing seam ears, each washer before its screw. These screws are longer than the knee-cap screws. Keep the holder engaged for the cylinder connections.

manual.title: Mount hip cylinder 1
manual.body: Carry any PV-200 complete cartridge using one elevator shelf trip. With the leg holder engaged, lower its upper parking lugs into the clevis hooks and guide the lower eye onto its prepared rest. Assisted seating captures both rests at neutral length. Fit one PV-P60220 pin through the upper eye, then a second through the lower eye; each pin includes its captive keeper. The front two cartridges use front pin entry; the rear cartridge uses rear entry. Operate this cartridge's captive neutral lock after both pins are fitted.

manual.title: Mount hip cylinder 2
manual.body: Carry any PV-200 complete cartridge using one elevator shelf trip. With the leg holder engaged, lower its upper parking lugs into the clevis hooks and guide the lower eye onto its prepared rest. Assisted seating captures both rests at neutral length. Fit one PV-P60220 pin through the upper eye, then a second through the lower eye; each pin includes its captive keeper. The front two cartridges use front pin entry; the rear cartridge uses rear entry. Operate this cartridge's captive neutral lock after both pins are fitted.

manual.title: Mount hip cylinder 3
manual.body: Carry any PV-200 complete cartridge using one elevator shelf trip. With the leg holder engaged, lower its upper parking lugs into the clevis hooks and guide the lower eye onto its prepared rest. Assisted seating captures both rests at neutral length. Fit one PV-P60220 pin through the upper eye, then a second through the lower eye; each pin includes its captive keeper. The front two cartridges use front pin entry; the rear cartridge uses rear entry. Operate this cartridge's captive neutral lock after both pins are fitted.

manual.title: Left leg structurally secured
manual.body: Both retaining halves, all ring and stop-cage hardware, all three cylinders and their six eye pins are required. Operate each cylinder's captive neutral lock at its exposed index rail. Only then can Advance release the holder: open contacts, lower, withdraw 1.4 m rearward, compact and shift 2 m outboard. Return turns and travels the empty holder home without moving the installed leg. Stop and Advance hold/resume a phase. Reacquire holder support before unlocking a cylinder or undoing retention.

manual.title: Reacquire support and recover
manual.body: If the empty holder has returned home, use Advance through travel, tilt and upward docking to bring it back under the mounted leg. The final docking motion automatically closes the holder jaws and reacquires support. If the released holder is already docked, Advance directly reacquires support. Wait for the holder to report engaged before any retention undo. Z removes the most recent bolt, washer and half in reverse order. Each half returns to your hands at the actual connection; store it on the lift shelf and ride to Ground. Remove every fitted retention piece before rail Return can unseat the leg, lower, reverse tilt and travel home, one phase per press. The same physical components can be installed again. Never remove retention while the holder is released.

manual.title: Travel and seat the supported leg
manual.body: The pelvis bridge, both sockets and their bridge bolts are supplied context. Keep the rail engaged throughout travel, tilt and upward docking. Use local rail Advance controls through each supported stage; Stop holds the current stage. Retention is performed from the personnel lift. Retention blocks loaded Return.

manual.title: Seat the leg in the pelvis
manual.body: With the completed leg, neutral source roll and parked empty crane, select the right hip lane. Advance first stows the foot bolster, then indexes and pins the transverse table. Further Advance commands travel, turn upright and dock upward. The shared hip platforms open before loaded movement and restore after seating. The holder stays engaged: ball seating alone does not secure the leg.

manual.title: Seat the prepared chest
manual.body: With the pelvis clamped on the gantry and both waist neutral pins engaged, use Chest to waist. Fit all four lifting shoes, take weight, travel upright and lower the chest onto the four waist keys. The crane stays attached while the chest is unfastened.

diagram_views.title: Prepared chest onto the locked waist

manual.title: Retain the chest on the waist
manual.body: Fit each CH-W36 washer before its CH-H36160 M36 × 160 bolt. All four bolts enter downward into the waist's captive threads. Keep the cockpit fitted and the four front/rear connection windows open. Complete all four pairs before releasing the lifting shoes.

manual.title: Connect chest services
manual.body: After all four waist bolt pairs are fitted, release and stow all four crane shoes. Fit the two identical CH-SERVICE plugs at the outward-facing waist couplings. Keep the waist neutral pins engaged.

manual.title: Prepared chest and cockpit
manual.body: The chest frame, enclosed cockpit, fixed shoulder cups and neck spoke are supplied assembled. Use Chest to fixture at the shared crane to transfer it from storage after selecting chest inserts on the empty bulky fixture. Keep the fitted cockpit upright. After checking the supported unit, lower the fixture to its pickup stop and choose Chest to waist. The pelvis manual owns seating, retention and service connections.

manual.title: Deliver and guide the core
manual.body: Select core saddles on the empty bulky fixture, then use Core to fixture to collect the prepared cartridge. Core to rear dock follows the low right-side bypass, outboard lift and high crossing. Down brings the horizontal load to the rear approach with both ends fitted. At the right-side guide control, Advance stops at captured engagement. Release and stow the forward equalizing bridge using its side handle; keep the aft end fitted. Advance folds the unloaded forward equalizer and shifts its head aft before inserting farther. The aft end and captured guides stay engaged. Advance again, if stopped, completes flange and keyed-nose seating.

manual.title: Retain and connect the core
manual.body: Operate all four PC-H16 captive flange bolts, then complete the rear interlock connection. The aft crane end remains fitted through both operations. Release and stow that end only when all four bolts and the rear connection are secure. For local correction, isolate the connection, refit the aft end and release all four bolts. Return stops at guide capture. Return again extends the empty forward rig; refit its bridge before returning out of the guides.

manual.title: Seat the open backpack
manual.body: Select backpack inserts on the empty bulky fixture and collect the prepared unit with Backpack to fixture. Select Backpack to hinges, attach both ends and follow the rear delivery route. Down aligns both open hinge eyes with the fixed chest forks; keep both crane ends attached.

diagram_views.title: Open backpack onto fixed hinge forks

manual.title: Retain both backpack hinges
manual.body: Insert each BP-P60 hinge pin from the outboard side, then fit its BP-K60 keeper into the exposed inner groove. Both complete pin/keeper pairs are required before extending the struts.

manual.title: Attach the backpack struts
manual.body: At each free strut-end handle, Extend guides the prepared telescope to its fixed chest clevis. Fit the BP-P40 base pin and its BP-K40 keeper. Engage both positive open locks before releasing either crane end.

manual.title: Connect the supported backpack
manual.body: With both struts positively locked open, release and stow both crane ends. Fit both BP-SERVICE protected runs at the fixed rear-facing sockets. The upper retained loops move with the cover; they provide no lifting support.

manual.title: Close and latch the backpack
manual.body: Return the matching crane, refit both ends, then choose Take backpack weight. Release both strut locks at their handles. Choose Close backpack at the crane; Stop/Resume preserves partial closure. At the closed stop engage both lower draw latches, release and stow the crane ends, then close the two small service covers. For correction, reopen the covers, refit both ends and take weight before releasing either latch. Open fully and engage both strut locks before releasing the crane or changing service connections.

manual.title: Left shoulder: deliver the retained arm
manual.body: Use Cassette to station after parking the leg cradle. Select Left arm to shoulder. Attach all four ends, then Up takes weight and folds the six source clamps. Travel upends, yaws and splays the restrained arm; Down approaches and seats the ball. The crane keeps carrying it.

diagram_views.title: Left shoulder deliver the retained arm

manual.title: Left shoulder: retain the ball
manual.body: Fit SH-RING-FRONT and SH-RING-REAR radially around the seated neck. Their complementary seam keys locate the halves. Fit each SH-WASHER before its SH-BOLT. Keep all four crane ends attached.

manual.title: Left shoulder: fit the neutral brace
manual.body: Seat SH-BRACE-LEFT on the fixed bridge tabs and the arm's two staggered keys. Fit both SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER pairs. The keyed brace locks the straight service pose while the crane carries the arm.

diagram_views.title: Left shoulder fit the neutral brace

manual.title: Left shoulder: drive 1
manual.body: Fit one SH-DRIVE between the fixed A clevis and moving B eye. Retain both ends with SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER. All three cartridges share the same compatible type.

manual.title: Left shoulder: drive 2
manual.body: Fit one SH-DRIVE between the fixed A clevis and moving B eye. Retain both ends with SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER. All three cartridges share the same compatible type.

manual.title: Left shoulder: drive 3
manual.body: Fit one SH-DRIVE between the fixed A clevis and moving B eye. Retain both ends with SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER. All three cartridges share the same compatible type.

manual.title: Left shoulder: connect services
manual.body: At the crane console, check all three drive brakes and transfer weight onto the retained cup, drives and keyed brace. Fit SH-SERVICE between the isolated ports, then detach and stow all four crane ends. Keep the neutral and joint restraints engaged for pauldron work.

manual.title: Right shoulder: deliver the retained arm
manual.body: Use Cassette to station after parking the leg cradle. Select Right arm to shoulder. Attach all four ends, then Up takes weight and folds the six source clamps. Travel upends, yaws and splays the restrained arm; Down approaches and seats the ball. The crane keeps carrying it.

diagram_views.title: Right shoulder deliver the retained arm

manual.title: Right shoulder: retain the ball
manual.body: Fit SH-RING-FRONT and SH-RING-REAR radially around the seated neck. Their complementary seam keys locate the halves. Fit each SH-WASHER before its SH-BOLT. Keep all four crane ends attached.

manual.title: Right shoulder: fit the neutral brace
manual.body: Seat SH-BRACE-RIGHT on the fixed bridge tabs and the arm's two staggered keys. Fit both SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER pairs. The keyed brace locks the straight service pose while the crane carries the arm.

diagram_views.title: Right shoulder fit the neutral brace

manual.title: Right shoulder: drive 1
manual.body: Fit one SH-DRIVE between the fixed A clevis and moving B eye. Retain both ends with SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER. All three cartridges share the same compatible type.

manual.title: Right shoulder: drive 2
manual.body: Fit one SH-DRIVE between the fixed A clevis and moving B eye. Retain both ends with SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER. All three cartridges share the same compatible type.

manual.title: Right shoulder: drive 3
manual.body: Fit one SH-DRIVE between the fixed A clevis and moving B eye. Retain both ends with SH-PIN and SH-KEEPER. All three cartridges share the same compatible type.

manual.title: Right shoulder: connect services
manual.body: At the crane console, check all three drive brakes and transfer weight onto the retained cup, drives and keyed brace. Fit SH-SERVICE between the isolated ports, then detach and stow all four crane ends. Keep the neutral and joint restraints engaged for pauldron work.

manual.title: Left pauldron: deliver carrier
manual.body: With the shoulder retained, brakes checked, weight transferred and services connected, stow all arm crane ends. Select Left pauldron at the central crane console. Its upright passive store is in small stock at X-9.0, Z1. Fit both front/rear ends and lift above the guards; travel via front Z13, then lower through the open deck notch. Keep both ends attached.

manual.title: Left pauldron: retain carrier
manual.body: Pocket two PD-M20-LONG bolt units and two PD-M20-SHORT bolt units. The long captive shoes span the proximal bosses; the short shoes fit the distal pair. Fit from front/rear into the arm-owned bosses, clamping the carrier ledges after seating. Keep both crane ends attached. Reacquire both ends before any local bolt correction.

manual.title: Left pauldron: front closure
manual.body: Release and stow both crane ends. Carry PD-FRONT with two hands on an elevator shelf. Fit the upper panel and fasten its four captive M12 screws. The permanent lower mechanical window stays open.

manual.title: Left pauldron: rear closure
manual.body: Carry PD-REAR with two hands on an elevator shelf. Fit the upper strip and fasten its four captive M12 screws; leave the lower mechanical window open. Once both panels close, release the elbow/wrist restraints and digit cradle at their local handles. Re-engage them before reopening panels for correction.

manual.title: Right pauldron: deliver carrier
manual.body: With the shoulder retained, brakes checked, weight transferred and services connected, stow all arm crane ends. Select Right pauldron at the central crane console. Its upright passive store is in small stock at X-5.0, Z1. Fit both front/rear ends and lift above the guards; travel via front Z13, then lower through the open deck notch. Keep both ends attached.

manual.title: Right pauldron: retain carrier
manual.body: Pocket two PD-M20-LONG bolt units and two PD-M20-SHORT bolt units. The long captive shoes span the proximal bosses; the short shoes fit the distal pair. Fit from front/rear into the arm-owned bosses, clamping the carrier ledges after seating. Keep both crane ends attached. Reacquire both ends before any local bolt correction.

manual.title: Right pauldron: front closure
manual.body: Release and stow both crane ends. Carry PD-FRONT with two hands on an elevator shelf. Fit the upper panel and fasten its four captive M12 screws. The permanent lower mechanical window stays open.

manual.title: Right pauldron: rear closure
manual.body: Carry PD-REAR with two hands on an elevator shelf. Fit the upper strip and fasten its four captive M12 screws; leave the lower mechanical window open. Once both panels close, release the elbow/wrist restraints and digit cradle at their local handles. Re-engage them before reopening panels for correction.

manual.title: Head baseplate: deliver
manual.body: Fit matching head baseplate upright inserts on the empty lowered bulky fixture. Use Head baseplate to fixture to collect the passive-store piece, retain on the saddles, release and park. Select Head baseplate; attach every magnetic end individually. Up tensions the rig before clamps open. Lift until the lowest load is Y19, cross to X13 at Z13, then to Z26 with front wings closed. Down aligns the keyed front and lowers 24 cm onto the seat. Keep the rig attached. The underside starts at robot Z15.64: 6 cm to pilot entry, then 18 cm to the flange; the front key rejects reversed yaw.

manual.title: Head baseplate: retain
manual.body: Fit four HD-W24 4 mm washers and four HD-M24160 bolts down into the torso's captive flange threads. Work from the open front before shells close access; the rear pair uses the specified deeper tool lane. Keep all ends attached until retention is complete; reacquire every end before a local bolt correction.

manual.title: Head baseplate: connect loom
manual.body: After all four neck bolt/washer pairs, plug the keyed central power/data loom and bond at the exposed front disconnects. Clip strain relief up the right portal, keeping bolt lanes and the future sensor slide clear. Then release and stow both upward magnetic ends from the open front before either side shell.

manual.title: Left wraparound side: deliver
manual.body: Fit matching left wraparound side upright inserts on the empty lowered bulky fixture. Use Left wraparound side to fixture to collect the passive-store piece, retain on the saddles, release and park. Select Left wraparound side; attach every magnetic end individually. Up tensions the rig before clamps open. Lift until the lowest load is Y19, cross to X13 at Z13, then to Z26 with front wings closed. Down aligns the keyed front and lowers 22 cm onto the seat. Keep the rig attached. The side pockets/hooks and roof ledges remain open to vertical entry; either handed side may be fitted first.

manual.title: Left wraparound side: retain
manual.body: Fit both HD-M12100 bolts rearward through the exposed side-shell recesses into captive upright threads. Keep all ends attached until retention is complete; reacquire every end before a local bolt correction.

manual.title: Right wraparound side: deliver
manual.body: Fit matching right wraparound side upright inserts on the empty lowered bulky fixture. Use Right wraparound side to fixture to collect the passive-store piece, retain on the saddles, release and park. Select Right wraparound side; attach every magnetic end individually. Up tensions the rig before clamps open. Lift until the lowest load is Y19, cross to X13 at Z13, then to Z26 with front wings closed. Down aligns the keyed front and lowers 22 cm onto the seat. Keep the rig attached. The side pockets/hooks and roof ledges remain open to vertical entry; either handed side may be fitted first.

manual.title: Right wraparound side: retain
manual.body: Fit both HD-M12100 bolts rearward through the exposed side-shell recesses into captive upright threads. Keep all ends attached until retention is complete; reacquire every end before a local bolt correction.

manual.title: Structural head top: deliver
manual.body: Fit matching structural head top upright inserts on the empty lowered bulky fixture. Use Structural head top to fixture to collect the passive-store piece, retain on the saddles, release and park. Select Structural head top; attach every magnetic end individually. Up tensions the rig before clamps open. Lift until the lowest load is Y19, cross to X13 at Z13, then to Z26 with front wings closed. Down aligns the keyed front and lowers 22 cm onto the seat. Keep the rig attached. The side pockets/hooks and roof ledges remain open to vertical entry; either handed side may be fitted first.

manual.title: Structural head top: retain
manual.body: Fit four HD-M12160 bolts horizontally through the exposed roof-ear recesses into captive side-frame threads. Rear bolts enter forward from the rear flanks; front bolts enter rearward from the front landing. Keep all ends attached until retention is complete; reacquire every end before a local bolt correction.

manual.title: Sensor carrier: slide onto guides
manual.body: Bench preparation is supplied: two interchangeable cameras and one distinct range sensor, two M6 screws each, wired on HD-SENSORS. Carry with two hands; use one elevator shelf trip with the padded grips. With structural top retained and every end stowed, approach 1 m forward, then slide straight rearward through the open front. The unequal guide shoes reject reversed orientation; captured rails and the rear stop support the seated carrier.

manual.title: Sensor carrier: retain
manual.body: Tighten the four captive M8 carrier bolts at their front heads after the rails capture the carrier. The two-camera and range-sensor preparation screws are already supplied; no loose module stock is required.

manual.title: Sensor carrier: connect and check
manual.body: Plug the single keyed power/data connection near the lower right front. Clip the prepared short service loop inside the right portal, clear of the guides and all three optical apertures. Check all three modules before closing the faceplate.

manual.title: Front faceplate: seat
manual.body: Carry HD-FACE with both hands on the elevator shelf. After all four carrier bolts and its keyed power/data check, approach 18 cm forward and translate rearward onto the two lower support ledges and side-frame locators. The ledges support fastening; the camera and range openings remain clear.

manual.title: Front faceplate: retain
manual.body: Fit all four HD-M10080 M10 × 80 front bolts rearward into the independent frame bosses. All four are required before fitting the mask; support ledges alone do not retain the faceplate.

manual.title: Samurai mask: hook
manual.body: Carry HD-MASK on the enlarged shared shelf with two hands. With the faceplate fully retained, approach 16 cm forward and 10 cm high. Translate rearward, then lower 10 cm onto the two independent hooks outside the faceplate edges. Once hooked the mask is hands-free, ready for its uplift bolts.

manual.title: Samurai mask: retain
manual.body: Fit both HD-M10160 M10 × 160 front bolts rearward into the lower portal bosses. These prevent uplift; hooks alone are temporary support. For a local correction before the crown, undo both bolts, lift the mask clear into free hands, then refit that same mask and both bolts.

manual.title: Decorative head crown: deliver
manual.body: Fit matching decorative head crown upright inserts on the empty lowered bulky fixture. Use Decorative head crown to fixture to collect the passive-store piece, retain on the saddles, release and park. Select Decorative head crown; attach every magnetic end individually. Up tensions the rig before clamps open. Lift until the lowest load is Y19, cross to X13 at Z13, then to Z26 with front wings closed. Down aligns the keyed front and lowers 18 cm onto the seat. Keep the rig attached. After mask retention, the final crown lowers 18 cm: 6 cm clear lead and 12 cm onto the two unequal keyed prongs. Keep both front-facing ends attached.

manual.title: Decorative head crown: retain
manual.body: Fit both HD-M12100 M12 × 100 front bolts rearward through the crown feet into the independent keyed root bosses. Only after both bolts are complete may the two front-facing magnetic ends be released and stowed. Keep all ends attached until retention is complete; reacquire every end before a local bolt correction.

manual.title: Prepared core cartridge
manual.body: The core cartridge, keyed rails and four captive retaining bolts are supplied. Keep it horizontal on the bulky fixture's core saddles. Its forward equalizing bridge captures two side pads; the aft end attaches to the rear pad. The chest manual owns guide insertion, retention and rear connection.

manual.title: Prepared open backpack
manual.body: The backpack frame, rear cover, nozzles, hinge eyes, telescopic struts and lower latches are supplied together. Fit backpack perimeter inserts on the empty bulky fixture, then use Backpack to fixture to collect this same unit from its storage saddles. Its front face rests downward, in the fully open installation orientation. Two structural lifting pads carry it with the shared spreader.

manual.title: Shared arm cassette
manual.body: Park the leg cradle before bringing the cassette into the common limb station. The cassette holds the prepared arm on three saddles and six clamps. Use the shared crane's Cassette to station task, fit all four ends, then raise and transfer the retained cassette. Its floor locks engage before the crane releases. Reverse the same task to park an unfinished arm without changing its construction.

manual.title: Prepared left arm
manual.body: The upper arm, restrained elbow, forearm, neutral wrist and retained hand are supplied together. The shared cassette supports three structural pads; four structural lifting faces carry the arm. Shoulder retention, drives, services and pauldron work belong to the chest manual.

manual.title: Prepared right arm
manual.body: The upper arm, restrained elbow, forearm, neutral wrist and retained hand are supplied together. The shared cassette supports three structural pads; four structural lifting faces carry the arm. Shoulder retention, drives, services and pauldron work belong to the chest manual.

manual.title: Prepared pauldron carrier
manual.body: Open bottom and inboard cavity; use the two front/rear rig plates. Mounting bolts and panels belong to the chest manual.

manual.title: Prepared pauldron carrier
manual.body: Open bottom and inboard cavity; use the two front/rear rig plates. Mounting bolts and panels belong to the chest manual.

manual.title: Head baseplate preparation supplied
manual.body: Upright structural frames, locating tabs and magnetic pads are prepared. The chest manual owns installation and external hardware.

main_input.label: FA-605 · Main input harness with both plugs

manual.title: Prepared foot, empty leg rail
manual.body: The complete 135-piece foot is supplied on its carrier. The horizontal leg rail and pelvis connections are empty. Build the leg here, then open the pelvis manual for rail travel, seating and retention. Knee and ankle transport braces are equipment, not loose parts.

manual.title: Dock the prepared foot
manual.body: Keep the holder at the shared limb station with neutral roll. At the foot carrier, Advance raises the complete foot, Advance moves it to the receiving bolster, and Advance turns and seats it horizontally. The holder takes contact before the carrier releases and withdraws. Stop holds any transfer; Advance resumes it.

manual.title: Deliver the structural shin
manual.body: At the central crane console, with the empty crane parked and both magnetic ends stowed, select the Structural shin task. Choose Go to its rack, then Down. Q closes the console; click commands or use arrow keys and E. At the rack E picks up a magnetic end; aim and click either free marked point, then attach the other end. Either end fits either point. Q stows a held end. Choose Up to take weight, Go to Leg cradle, then Down to seat LG-100 against the already fitted foot adapter. The crane lowers the component, then approaches along the leg to mate the connection. Keep both ends attached until this task's retaining hardware is complete.

manual.title: Secure the ankle flange
manual.body: Collect four W-36 washers and four H-36090 bolts into pockets. Fit each washer before its bolt on the exposed shin flange. Approach the bolt heads from the knee side of the flange and insert toward the foot into the already fitted FA-201 adapter. After all four pairs, detach and stow both magnetic ends, raise and park the empty crane before changing task.

manual.title: Connect the shin disconnect
manual.body: Carry FA-605 with both attached plugs. Approach from the side away from the crane racks, standing back toward the knee. Leave room for the upright harness to turn clear of the ankle brace before fitting it. Seat its box end in the already fitted FA-604 socket, follow the foot guide clips and seat the upper keyed plug in LG-100's angled socket. The harness and knee-bearing branches can be completed in either order after the ankle bolts. Unplug this harness before separating foot and shin.

manual.title: Seat bearings and thrust spacers
manual.body: Carry and fit the two LG-130 bearings from opposite sides of the shin knee boss, then one LG-135 thrust spacer against each end. Bearings are interchangeable with bearings; spacers are interchangeable with spacers. Keep the marked knee axle extraction aisle clear.

manual.title: Deliver the knee fork
manual.body: At the central crane console, with the empty crane parked and both magnetic ends stowed, select the Knee fork task. Choose Go to its rack, then Down. Q closes the console; click commands or use arrow keys and E. At the rack E picks up a magnetic end; aim and click either free marked point, then attach the other end. Either end fits either point. Q stows a held end. Choose Up to take weight, Go to Leg cradle, then Down to seat LG-110 against the already fitted shin knee boss and thrust spacers. The crane lowers the component, then approaches along the leg to mate the connection. Keep both ends attached until this task's retaining hardware is complete.

manual.title: Insert the knee axle
manual.body: Carry LG-140 lengthwise with both hands. Insert from the right leg's outward (+X) axle aisle through the seated fork and bearings. The cap and its screws fit on the inner side. Keep the crane and rail brace engaged.

manual.title: Retain the knee axle
manual.body: Walk to the opposite side from the marked axle extraction aisle. Fit LG-150 on the exposed axle end, then two LG-W12 washers and two LG-H12050 screws, each washer before its screw. With the axle and both cap pairs complete, detach and stow both magnetic ends, raise and park the empty crane.

manual.title: Deliver the Upper-leg beam
manual.body: At the central crane console, with the empty crane parked and both magnetic ends stowed, select the Upper-leg beam task. Choose Go to its rack, then Down. Q closes the console; click commands or use arrow keys and E. At the rack E picks up a magnetic end; aim and click either free marked point, then attach the other end. Either end fits either point. Q stows a held end. Choose Up to take weight, Go to Leg cradle, then Down to seat LG-120 against the already fitted fork flange. The crane lowers the component, then approaches along the leg to mate the connection. Keep both ends attached until this task's retaining hardware is complete.

manual.title: Fasten the Upper-leg beam flange
manual.body: Pocket four LG-W24 washers and four LG-H24100 bolts. Fit each washer and then its bolt through the exposed flange corners into the already fitted fork. Approach the bolt heads from the hip side of the flange and insert toward the knee. These M24 x 100 bolts differ from the pelvis M24 x 140 bolts. After every pair is fitted, detach and stow both magnetic ends, then raise and park the empty crane.

manual.title: Structural leg ready
manual.body: All leg construction is complete. Park the empty crane with both magnetic ends stowed. The shared holder can park an unfinished leg on the transverse table and retrieve it without losing progress. For rear work, park the movable platform, use Roll to raise the supported axis, then Roll to the next locked orientation. Return restores neutral roll, then construction height. Open the pelvis manual for delivery.

manual.title: Supported construction recovery
manual.body: Return the supported leg home before construction disassembly. Select the affected crane task, lower at the leg cradle and attach both magnetic ends to reacquire support before Z removes its retaining hardware. Reverse each task: remove all flange pairs before lifting shin or beam; remove cap screws, washers, cap and axle before lifting the fork. Up withdraws the supported part through the reverse axial approach; Go to its rack and Down returns it. Detach and stow only after rack contact. Undo FA-605 before shin removal. With all structural work removed and the rail home, foot-carrier Return reacquires the foot and reverses one guided phase per press; Return again lowers it to the dispatch position.

manual.title: Foot workshop
manual.body: Prepare both FA-302 heel pads and FA-500-P (pitch actuator). Use the foot bay controls to expose each side. Follow each branch to install and secure it before transferring the foot.

manual.title: Heel position 1
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). Stock the hardware from its drawers and select the matching pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Heel position 2
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). Stock the hardware from its drawers and select the matching pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Cradle clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (cradle clevis) from its shelf and fit it to FA-103. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Ring clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (ring clevis) from its shelf and fit it to FA-200. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Seat & pin actuator
manual.body: Carry the prepared FA-500-P and seat it here. At each end fit FA-221 (pin), FA-222 (keeper), W-12, then H-12030. The FA-500-P child manual covers its preparation.

manual.title: Prepare
manual.body: Suspend FA-302 (heel pad) at any preparation station. Collect FA-305 from its drawer, then fit one at each opening in any order.

manual.title: Bring together
manual.body: Carry the prepared FA-302 and seat it at an empty heel position. Open the parent foot manual to secure it. Hands work separately from your numbered pockets.

manual.title: Drive cartridge
manual.body: Start with FA-513 (motor) beside preparation C. Place it in the fixture, seat FA-514 on its flange, then fit four W-12 washers and four H-12040 screws in the upper holes.

manual.title: Coupling & bearing
manual.body: Fit FA-515 on the already fitted FA-514 output shaft. Position FA-522 in the preparation fixture; the fixture supports the exposed drive while you assemble it. Leave FA-515 unclamped.

manual.title: Lead screw
manual.body: Carry FA-516 (lead screw) from its shelf into the already fitted FA-522 bearing and FA-515 coupling. Clamp FA-515 with two W-12 washers and two H-12030 screws.

manual.title: Retain the shaft
manual.body: Seat FA-523 against the already fitted FA-522 bearing. Fit the FA-524 receiver collar half and clearance collar half around the shaft. Fit two W-12 washers and H-12030 screws through the clearance half into the receiver half.

manual.title: Travelling nut
manual.body: Fit FA-517 (travelling nut) onto the already fitted FA-516 lead screw.

manual.title: Output rod
manual.body: Carry FA-518 (output rod) from its shelf. Join it to the already fitted FA-517 travelling nut with two W-12 washers and two H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Enclose the drive
manual.body: Fit FA-510 around the exposed drive held by the preparation fixture. From the open rear end, secure the already fitted FA-513 motor with four W-12 and H-12040 pairs. Secure the already fitted FA-523 retainer from outside the housing with two more pairs.

manual.title: Guide key
manual.body: Engage FA-521 (guide key) in the longitudinal slot of the already fitted FA-518 rod. Its offset ears attach to the FA-510 housing with two W-12 washers and two H-12030 screws; the rod slides along the key.

manual.title: End sensors
manual.body: Seat both FA-528 probes in the FA-510 openings. Each external mounting flange takes W-12 and H-12030. Fit FA-530 in the round barrel port.

manual.title: Front guide & seals
manual.body: Slide FA-519 along the already fitted FA-518 rod into the FA-510 front shoulder. Place FA-520 on the rod. Fit the FA-529 rear cap gasket, with its extra clearance holes, at the motor end; fit the front cap gasket at the rod end.

manual.title: Close the housing
manual.body: Fit one FA-511 (front cap) and one FA-512 (rear cap). Secure each cap with four W-12 washers and four H-12050 screws.

manual.title: Base eye
manual.body: Fit FA-525 (base eye housing), one FA-526 spherical eye bearing, then one FA-527 eye retaining ring. Secure the housing with two W-12 washers and H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Rod eye
manual.body: Fit FA-525 (rod eye housing), one FA-526 spherical eye bearing, then one FA-527 eye retaining ring. Secure the housing with two W-12 washers and H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Ready to install
manual.body: FA-500-P is ready after all 91 pieces. Open the parent foot manual for installation.

The rail brace keeps the knee straight and crane assistance remains attached.
